panels.title: Healthy S3 backends
panels.description: Distinct RGW backends the michael pool currently considers healthy (of 48).

panels.title: Request TTFB (quantiles)
panels.description: Time to first response byte — michael+RGW latency without body streaming (request duration includes the transfer, so large blobs skew it).

panels.title: JWT verify cache hit ratio
panels.description: ECDSA verify cost is only paid on misses. restic reuses one token per session, so this should sit near 100%.

panels.title: Connection churn
panels.description: New TCP connections and TLS handshakes to RGW. Near zero once pools are warm; sustained churn means idle-pool exhaustion or backend churn.

panels.title: Connection reuse ratio
panels.description: Share of S3 requests served over a pooled connection.

panels.title: S3 TTFB p95 by method
panels.description: RGW response latency per S3 method. PUT includes the request body upload, so it tracks pack size, not gateway latency.

panels.title: TLS handshake duration (quantiles)
panels.description: Empty once pools are warm — no handshakes, no samples.

panels.title: S3 backend pool (48 RGW nodes over the fabric)

targets.expr: sum by (method, route) (rate({__name__="http.server.request.duration_sum", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (method, route) (rate({__name__="http.server.request.duration_count", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Average latency by route
panels.description: Mean request duration per method+route. Includes body streaming; pair with TTFB for latency-only.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, method, route) (rate({__name__="http.server.request.duration_bucket", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, route) (rate({__name__="http.server.request.duration_bucket", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, method, route) (rate({__name__="http.server.request.duration_bucket", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Running pods
panels.description: michael pods with a live container (cadvisor)

panels.title: Restarts / rollouts (1h)
panels.description: pods whose container start time changed in the last hour (restart or rollout)

targets.expr: count(group by (pod) (changes(container_start_time_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="yucca", pod=~"yucca-michael-.*", container="michael"}[1h]) > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Storage backend errors/s
panels.description: PutObject/GetObject failures against RGW (storage.backend.errors) — the signal that client 500s are the backend

panels.title: Running michael pods
panels.description: Pod count over time — dips are rollouts/evictions, steps are scale changes

panels.title: Storage backend errors by operation
panels.description: Backend (RGW) storage-operation failures by operation and blob type — added in michael 0.23.1

panels.title: michael logs
panels.description: All michael logs for the selected time range (maxLines=100000 — effectively uncapped).
